strings.admin.companion_intro: Open Brew by Weight Companion is an optional helper you run on a computer at home. It opens the Web UI over HTTPS on as many phones, tablets and computers as you like, and with a Linea Micra it can keep the La Marzocco connection so the controller's radio stays free for your scale. Once it runs on your network, it asks to connect here by itself.
strings.admin.companion_lm_approve_hint: On: once you approve, the controller hands the companion your La Marzocco account, encrypted, and the companion takes over the cloud connection. You can change this later.
strings.admin.companion_lm_hint: On: the companion talks to La Marzocco's cloud for the controller. The controller no longer keeps a secure cloud connection open or decodes its messages, so its Wi-Fi and processor stay free for your scale and your shot. Power, brew temperature and backflush work exactly the same, and if the companion goes away the controller connects on its own until it is back. Off: the controller always connects to the cloud and does that work itself, as it does without a companion, and the companion deletes its copy of your La Marzocco account.
strings.admin.companion_log_approve_hint: On: the companion keeps a copy of this controller's diagnostic log, so its history survives restarts and stays readable even while the controller is off. You can change this later.
strings.admin.companion_log_hint: On: the companion keeps a copy of this controller's diagnostic log, so its history survives restarts and busy periods, pages back beyond what the controller keeps in memory, and stays readable even while the controller is off. Off: the controller's log stays in its own memory only, as it does without a companion, and the companion keeps what it already stored.

strings.setup.note_weight_no_wifi: Without Wi-Fi, this setup network opens for a few minutes every time the machine is switched on. Turning the paddle on closes it right away so your scale can connect.
strings.setup.note_weight_saved: Brew by weight turns on when you tap Finish at the end of setup, or by itself when the setup network closes. This phone stays connected.
strings.setup.nothing_until_save: Nothing changes on the machine until you save.
strings.setup.part1_hint: Choose how you want to brew and set your own password. Everything is saved together at the end of this part.
strings.setup.part1_hint_choices: Choose how you want to brew. It is saved at the end of this part.
strings.setup.part1_hint_password: Replace the factory password with your own. It is saved at the end of this part.
strings.setup.part3_hint: Everything is already saved by then. Finish closes the setup network, and restarts the controller once if you chose to stop shots by weight.
strings.setup.part3_hint_on: Everything is already saved by then. Done closes the setup network.
strings.setup.part_wifi_hint: Connect the controller to your home network, check that it works, then save it so you can open the controller from your phone.
strings.setup.pass_note: Your password unlocks Admin and joins the setup network {x}. If you ever forget it, you can bring back the factory password from the machine's paddle without losing your recipes.
strings.setup.password_intro: The password you used to join this setup network is the factory one, and it is the same on every controller. Choose your own so nobody else can change your settings.
strings.setup.password_not_saved: The controller did not confirm the new password. Try again.
strings.setup.recipe_double_adaptive_hint: For a double basket. Stops at your target weight and adjusts a little for fast and slow shots.
strings.setup.recipe_double_fixed_hint: For a double basket. Always stops right at your target weight.
strings.setup.recipe_intro: You can switch recipes any time from the Home screen.
strings.setup.recipe_manual_hint: You stop each shot yourself while the controller weighs and times it. A relaxed way to get started.
strings.setup.recipe_single_adaptive_hint: For a single basket. Stops at your target weight and adjusts a little for fast and slow shots.
strings.setup.recipe_single_fixed_hint: For a single basket. Always stops right at your target weight.
strings.setup.replace_intro: Choose the network to use instead. {x} stays saved until you connect to the new one and save it.
strings.setup.saved_join_hint: Next time you join {x}, use your new password.
strings.setup.saved_part1_password: Part 1 saved: how you brew and your password.
strings.setup.saved_wifi: Wi-Fi saved. The controller joins {x} by itself every time it starts.
strings.setup.title: Connect to your Wi-Fi
strings.setup.welcome_intro: A controller is installed in this machine, but it is switched off: the machine works exactly as it always has. Setup has three short parts.
strings.setup.wifi_intro_usual: Optional. Lets you open the controller from your phone and switch on brew by weight whenever you like. The machine works without it.
strings.setup.wifi_intro_weight: Optional. Lets you open the controller from your phone at home. Brew by weight also works without Wi-Fi.
strings.setup.wifi_not_saved: The controller did not confirm the network yet. Try again.
strings.shell.firmware_rollback_named: Version {0} failed while starting, so the controller went back to version {1} on its own. Your settings weren't changed. Diagnostic may have saved details about what went wrong.
strings.shell.firmware_rollback_text: A new version failed while starting, so the controller went back to version {0} on its own. Your settings weren't changed. Diagnostic may have saved details about what went wrong.
strings.shell.firmware_updated_text: Your controller is now running version {0}.
strings.shell.forgot_help: Restore the factory password at the machine with the paddle or button recovery steps. Recipes, calibration and shot history are kept; Wi-Fi has to be set up again.
strings.shell.name: Name
strings.shell.out_of_reach_hint: The controller is out of reach of this device. Check that this phone or computer is connected to the same network as the controller, then press Reload.
strings.shell.pair_text: Allow it only if you just added this controller in Home Assistant and it shows the same code.
strings.shell.remember_this_device_hint: Stay signed in for 90 days. Turn this off on a shared or borrowed phone.
strings.shell.sign_in_intro: Enter the device password to use this coffee controller.
strings.shell.this_window_was_deactivated_due_to: This window was deactivated due to inactivity, or because another window was opened in a different browser or device. Press Reload to enable this window again.
strings.shell.wifi_failed_text: The controller couldn't confirm the connection to {0}, so it went back to the previous network. Check the network name and password, then try again.
strings.stats.bad_hint: Left out of statistics, charts and learning
strings.stats.beanconqueror_hint: Opens the Beanconqueror app on this device with the shot ready to save
strings.stats.beanconqueror_unsupported: This browser can’t build the Beanconqueror link.
strings.stats.csv_hint: A table of every good shot for Excel, Numbers or Sheets
strings.stats.export_after_shot: Available once the shot has finished
strings.stats.export_progress: Exporting shots with their traces… {0} of {1}
strings.stats.export_stopped_shot: Export stopped: a shot started. Export again once it has finished.
strings.stats.gaggiuino_hint: The curve only, for Gaggiuino tools and Visualizer.coffee
strings.stats.header_controller_only: For now these figures cover only the shots on the controller. Your whole history returns as soon as the companion catches up.
strings.stats.header_unavailable: These figures are not available right now. They return when the companion can read its copy again.
strings.stats.json_all_hint: Every shot, bad ones included, with each one’s trace, for backups and troubleshooting
strings.stats.json_shot_hint: This shot with its full curve and its trace when it has one, for backups and troubleshooting
strings.stats.note_exported_from: Exported from Open Brew by Weight {0}
strings.stats.pushed_shot_missing: The shot from that notification isn't available here.
strings.stats.trace_after_shot: The trace can be viewed once the shot has finished.
strings.stats.trace_failed: Could not load the shot trace
strings.stats.trace_interrupted: The controller restarted during this shot, so the trace ends where it stopped.
strings.stats.trace_none: This shot has no stored trace. The oldest traces make room for new ones.
strings.stats.trace_tail_dropped: Its last events were cut off by the restart.
strings.stats.trace_truncated: Some events did not fit and were left out ({0} scale events, {1} decisions).
strings.stats.trace_unreadable: This trace could not be read.
strings.stats.view_trace_hint: What the controller saw and decided during this shot
